nodes.summary: The transition kernel of a stochastic matrix: `finiteChainKernel P x` is the probability measure on `Fin (M + 1)` putting mass `P.prob x j` on each state `j`. This is the kernel form of the transition matrix.

nodes.summary: `IsFiniteMarkovChain X P ℱ μ` asserts that the sequence `X : ℕ → Ω → Fin (M+1)` is a Markov chain with transition matrix `P`, adapted to the filtration `ℱ`, under the measure `μ`. Concretely: each `X n` is `ℱ n`-measurable, and the conditional probability that `X (n+1) = j` given `ℱ n` equals `P.prob (X n) j`, matching the Markov property `P(X_{n+1} = j | X_n = i, ...) = P_{ij}`.
